global_emergency.helpline_desc: Call immediately (within 2 hours/golden hour) if any money was transferred or debited.
global_emergency.chakshu_desc: Report suspected fraudulent communication (calls, SMS, WhatsApp) directly to Telecom Ministry.
global_emergency.bank_action: Call your bank using the number on the back of your card or in the official app, ask to block the card/UPI and flag the transaction.

DIGITAL_ARREST_IMPERSONATION.headline: No agency conducts 'digital arrest' or asks for money transfers over video calls.
DIGITAL_ARREST_IMPERSONATION.advice: No police, CBI, Customs, ED, or court questions citizens over Skype/WhatsApp video call, or asks to move money to verify yourself. Hang up immediately. There is zero legal validity to 'digital arrest'.

UPI_COLLECT_OR_REFUND.headline: Entering a UPI PIN always DEDUCTS money from your account; it never receives money.
UPI_COLLECT_OR_REFUND.advice: If someone sent money 'by mistake', tell them to file a reversal through their own bank or UPI app. Never approve collect requests or enter UPI PIN to receive money.
UPI_COLLECT_OR_REFUND.bank_contact: Block UPI ID instantly in your banking app (GPay / PhonePe / Paytm / BHIM).

FAKE_JOB_OR_INTERNSHIP.headline: Genuine employers and AICTE-listed internships do not charge fees.
FAKE_JOB_OR_INTERNSHIP.advice: Legitimate companies never ask candidates for security deposits, laptop fees, police clearance charges, or registration fees via personal UPI IDs or free email domains.

KYC_OR_BANK_PHISHING.headline: Banks never send SMS with shortened links threatening same-day account freeze.
KYC_OR_BANK_PHISHING.advice: RBI guidelines explicitly forbid banks from asking for card numbers, PINs, OTPs, or CVV through SMS links. Visit your physical branch or open your bank's verified official app directly.
KYC_OR_BANK_PHISHING.bank_action: Call official bank helpline from the physical card to freeze NetBanking.

PARCEL_OR_CUSTOMS.headline: Customs department never calls victims directly demanding cash settlements via UPI.
PARCEL_OR_CUSTOMS.advice: Indian Customs and courier services (FedEx, DHL, India Post) communicate officially by registered post and never demand online transfers to personal accounts to clear narcotics or detained items.

INVESTMENT_OR_TRADING.headline: Guaranteed 100%+ returns and WhatsApp/Telegram stock tips are unregistered boiler-room scams.
INVESTMENT_OR_TRADING.advice: Verify all financial advisors on SEBI (sebi.gov.in). Never send money to private individual accounts for stock market or crypto trading.

LOTTERY_OR_PRIZE.headline: You cannot win a contest or lottery you never bought a ticket for.
LOTTERY_OR_PRIZE.advice: KBC, Kaun Banega Crorepati, automobile, or lucky-draw wins demanding 'GST clearance' or 'processing charge' are 100% advance-fee fraud.

TECH_SUPPORT_REMOTE_ACCESS.headline: Never install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or QuickSupport on instructions from an incoming caller.
TECH_SUPPORT_REMOTE_ACCESS.advice: Remote access apps grant full visual control of your screen and OTPs to scammers. Turn off Wi-Fi/Mobile Data immediately and uninstall the app.

SEXTORTION_BLACKMAIL.headline: Do not pay. Scammers demand more after every transfer. Disconnect and report.
SEXTORTION_BLACKMAIL.advice: Video calls recorded with morphed nudity are extortion rackets. Block the scammer, preserve screenshots, do not transfer any money, and report to 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in immediately.

LOAN_APP_HARASSMENT.headline: Illegal instant loan apps access contacts to blackmail. Lodge police and cyber complaints.
LOAN_APP_HARASSMENT.advice: Report unauthorized lending apps to RBI Sachet (sachet.rbi.org.in) and National Cyber Crime portal.

OTHER.headline: Stay calm. Scammers rely on artificial urgency and fear to block logical thinking.
OTHER.advice: Discuss the situation with a family member or friend before taking any financial action. Call 1930 if in doubt.

NONE.headline: No red flags found in this text, but always remain vigilant.
NONE.advice: Legitimate banking alerts will remind you never to share OTPs or passwords. Always verify sender identity directly through official channels.
